articles.title: Chinese ASI again targets European IP enforcement, prompting Dutch AASI backed by penalties of up to €100 million

articles.title: The Emerging Markets Everyone Else Is Missing
articles.description: Emerging markets have had a strong year, but much of that performance has been driven by a handful of AI-linked stocks. Merryn Somerset Webb speaks with Neuberger Berman portfolio managers Vera German and Juan Torres about where they’re finding value away from the crowded trade — from China and Brazil to Mexico, Kenya and Uzbekistan — and why they think some of the best opportunities are hiding far from the index. (Source: Bloomberg)
